name: Костёр
subject: ONE fantasy CAMPFIRE hearth: ring of EIGHT thick cubical warm-gray stones, four chunky crossed dark-oak logs within ring, dark charcoal ember bed and large Minecraft-stepped amber flame with pale cream centre and orange-red lower tongues. Broad readable cubes, flat colors; flame does NOT cast light or shadow onto backdrop. Hearth stones and fuel are asset itself, no dirt, terrain platform, smoke cloud or additional scenery.
caption: Пять ракурсов одной существующей постройки. Крупные воксели; без ландшафта, внешней подставки и подписей.
